'''Triben''' is a [[Saldaean]] soldier.

== Appearance ==
He is hawk-faced with a short, trimmed mustache and a scar on his forehead.

== Activities ==
He goes with [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] when she tries to track down the messenger boy, who was sent by King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]] to [[Milisair Chadmar]]. At Nynaeve's direction, he kicks in the door to the chandler's shop which was a front for the questioners prison. He knocks out one of the jailers with a punch to the gut, and accompanies Nynaeve into the dungeon.
